files.intent: Register Sprint M9 / SG-GEOM-AUTH-001: the Smart Guitar geometry authority package, its dispositions, and the contradictions already on main.

title: Register the Smart Guitar geometry authority package in SPRINTS.md

diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The current Smart Guitar design rulings exist only in session notes. docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md Rule 6 forbids chat-only notes as the system of record, which is how the 4.5 deg op20_status survived three supersessions unnoticed. No other SPRINTS entry carries body height, the 12th-fret attachment, the neck-angle band or the neck-pocket dispositions.
diff_articulation.what_changed: Appends one DATA INTEGRITY sprint section before ## COMPLETED. It records the owner's 2026-09-20 geometry package with a per-quantity disposition table (521.8 current working authority / 528.1 superseded / 438.15 reference only), the design-ruling-to-CAM authority chain, the provisional body-height-to-body_length_mm equivalence, the quantities derived from 528.1 that must be recomputed before reuse, and the contradictions re-read on main. No record file, schema or calculator is amended. Review pass 2026-09-20. Four findings from the risk assessment are incorporated: (1) the 12th-fret ruling is recorded as contradicting the join-fret fields themselves, naming the three Smart Guitar fields that carry one (v1 neck.neck_length.body_join_fret 'TBD 19 or 20', setup neck_relief.body_join_fret 19, sweep neck_joint_fret 19) and explicitly excluding explorer_baseline.neck_joint_fret 22 as a fact about the Explorer; (2) the scale staleness is widened from the solver block to smart_guitar_geometry.scale_mm 628.65, a governing field, against v1's revised 647.7, with parent_models scale values excluded for the same reason; (3) 26.59 is relabelled from an asserted pocket requirement to what the record actually holds -- a neck-and-fretboard stack at the 12th fret, sourced from the Explorer, with no derivation connecting it to a pocket depth -- and the 17.86 floor figure is marked as inheriting that ungoverned premise; (4) the 47.0 claim is scoped to the grep that supports it. Three further defects found while verifying: the record states the owner neck-angle band as 1.5-2.5 deg three times at setup_spec:43 while this entry states 1.5-2.0, which is now flagged unreconciled rather than silently resolved; the solver sweep was cited from its 10-13mm rows only, and the full nine-row table gates GREEN from 1.13 to 3.31 deg so it discriminates nothing and is now marked not usable as manufacturing evidence; and the record's own note that the heel stack is unmeasured is quoted, since it independently refutes using a 12th-fret figure as the shoulder requirement.

intent: Give the geometry reconciliation a system-of-record starting point that preserves the authority distinctions exactly, without prematurely claiming CAD verification. Review pass 2026-09-20 addresses the PR #388 risk assessment. The entry is relabelled an OBSERVATION RECORD whose arithmetic is an observation about the records and never derived geometry authority; the op20_status safety stop is promoted to a blockquote at the top stating that nothing has been corrected and OP20 is not safe to run at any angle; the cross-repo source is given as a full SHA with a public permalink and both file paths; and the cited record files are pinned by blob id, since line numbers drift.
